BillCategory.title: BillCategory
BillCategory.description: Represents a user-defined household utility bill folder such as Gas, Electricity, or Water.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user owning this category.

name.description: Display name of the bill category (e.g., فاتورة الغاز).

defaultUnit.description: Default measurement unit for consumption (e.g., م³, ك.و.س).

alertThresholdPercent.description: Percentage spike threshold vs previous bill that triggers variance alerts.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

BillRecord.title: BillRecord
BillRecord.description: Represents a single monthly utility bill entry with extracted OCR details and structured sheet rows.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user owning this bill.

categoryId.description: Document ID of the parent BillCategory.

categoryName.description: Denormalized category name for analytics and export.

billingMonth.description: Year-month bucket for monthly chart aggregation (YYYY-MM).

billDateEpochMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the bill date for chronological comparison.

totalAmount.description: Total financial amount due on the bill.

previousReading.description: Previous meter reading extracted or entered.

currentReading.description: Current meter reading extracted or entered.

rawExtractedText.description: Raw OCR text extracted from the bill image.

notes.description: User notes attached to this bill.

sourceType.description: How this bill was created (manual entry or camera AI extraction).

sheetItems.description: Bounded list (<= 25) of structured detail row maps ({label, value, unit}) extracted from the bill.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

HouseholdBudget.title: HouseholdBudget
HouseholdBudget.description: Represents the user's monthly household budget configuration for tracking total expenses across bill categories.

userId.description: UID of the authenticated Google user owning this budget.

currency.description: Currency symbol or code for the monthly budget.

warningPercent.description: Percentage of monthlyLimit (e.g., 80) at which an approaching-limit warning is shown.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp on creation (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp on last update (clients must submit FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/bills/{billId}.description: User-owned monthly utility bill entries and structured detail sheets.

/budgets/{budgetId}.description: User-owned monthly household budget configuration where budgetId equals userId.
